name: What types of paint are best for a new home addition?

mainEntity.name: What types of paint are best for a new home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best types of paint for a new home addition depend on the specific area and its intended use. For interior walls, durable latex paints with a matte or eggshell finish are popular for their washability and aesthetic appeal. High-traffic areas like hallways or kitchens might benefit from a satin or semi-gloss finish for increased durability and easier cleaning. Exterior additions require weather-resistant acrylic or latex paints designed for outdoor exposure. A practical tradeoff to consider is between paint durability and sheen: higher sheens are generally more durable and easier to clean but can highlight imperfections more readily.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable latex paints are good for interior walls; satin or semi-gloss for high-traffic areas; weather-resistant acrylic/latex for exteriors.
